policy: Preserve independently justified behavior. Protected financial, database and recovery tests and coverage thresholds remain unchanged. On 2026-10-18 the owner removed the Playwright browser journeys while the Swift native app was the intended UI. That app was retired on 2026-10-19 and the journeys were not restored, so React web layout has no browser coverage. On 2026-10-19 ADR-215 made structure-only tests (source text, mock call order, SQL strings sent to mocks, private helpers) deletable with a one-line reason; behaviour they alone covered gets a boundary test.

reviewedTests.decision: remove; React web layout coverage dropped by owner decision
reviewedTests.reason: Counts and exact CSS spellings prevent valid refactors and cannot prove fit. The browser geometry journeys that replaced it were removed on 2026-10-18 with Playwright, while the Swift native app (retired 2026-10-19) was the intended UI; no React layout coverage remains.
Preserve currency-partition conservation, retry safety and no partial close; SQL call indices are implementation-bound. No browser or PostgreSQL close journey replaces it.
Database money precision is a domain contract independent of implementation.
Payment sum and remaining amount conservation protects financial outcomes.
Units and cost-basis conservation remain required after redesign. Expected values must follow requirements, not implementation output.
Historical dedup hash compatibility is persisted identity; replacing the algorithm must deliberately preserve or migrate it.
Identical coverage retained by tests/golden/dedupHash.golden.test.ts.

reviewedTests.boundary: synthetic filesystem and restore failure injection
reviewedTests.reason: Safety ordering, rollback and recoverability need deterministic fault coverage beyond successful end-to-end runs.
Restart recovery must survive interruption at intermediate phases.
Useful contract validation; explicitly not a UI journey.
1000-recipient bounded rendering plus End-key focus/toggle; not a class-name or private-helper assertion.
Observable zero hidden requests and fetching after user enables widgets; supports internal query refactoring.

Money sign and typography consistency matters; component-name and CSS adoption lists couple it to implementation. A suitable lint rule or rendered money semantics must replace coverage before removal.
